messages:
Priya (People Ops): Need approval routing for an exception. Candidate Lucas Vega, Senior Backend Eng. Requested compband S4 (current guideline S3). Also asking for early start 2026-04-15 and a split sign-on (2 installments). Any blockers?
Sam (Hiring Mgr): +1 on S4 based on market comp data and seniority. Start 4/15 works for the team.
Marta (Recruiter): Candidate confirmed 3 week notice but can target 4/15. Asked about benefits effective date — candidate wants to know first-day coverage.
Aisha (Compben): Please post total comp breakdown and rationale for S4 exception. Also state sign-on schedule and whether it's retention-contingent.
Priya (People Ops): Breakdown pasted below:
```
base: $170,000
bonus (target): $15,000
sign-on: $30,000 (15k on first payroll, 15k at 6 months subject to employment)
equity (4yr): $40,000 grant value
total OTE year1: $255,000
```
Jordan (Finance): Budget check needed. Suggest capping immediate sign-on to $15k and hold remainder as retention. Can we split 15/15?
Sam (Hiring Mgr): We prefer 30k total, 15/15 split is fine if retention is documented. Manager will own 6mo check-in.
Aisha (Compben): FYI policy: any sign-on > $25k requires VP People approval. Benefits eligibility: medical eligible first of month after start or same day if start before plan cutoff — will confirm plan cutoff date.
offer-bot: Offer created in Greenhouse GH-12345, initial routing: people-ops -> compben -> finance -> vp-people.
Priya (People Ops): Tagging @Lina for S4 + sign-on >25k approval. Lina, can you review?
Marta (Recruiter): Lina pinged via DM. Candidate prefers clear sign-on schedule in writing.
Lina (VP People): Reviewed. Approving S4 exception and $30k sign-on with 15k immediate + 15k at 6 months conditional on employment and manager confirmation. Require manager to add retention goals to the JD / onboarding plan. Approving now :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Finance): Budget owner confirms. Finance will process 15k on first payroll after start, remaining 15k after verification at 6 months. Please ensure payroll code and GL account are set.
Aisha (Compben): I'll update the offer letter language to specify the 6-month retention condition and benefits effective date (medical: first payroll date after start).
Priya (People Ops): Thanks — Marta, can you get candidate sign-off and update GH? Then I'll route final paperwork and benefits enrollment.
Marta (Recruiter): Candidate accepted verbally this morning. Updating Greenhouse now and sending formal offer.
offer-bot: Candidate accepted. Offer GH-12345 status -> accepted.
Priya (People Ops): Great — final steps: send benefits packet, set benefits effective date per compben, and schedule 6mo retention check reminder for manager. Closing thread once packet sent. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
